about: Every result the manuscript quotes: key -> results file, RFC 6901 pointer, format, the grid job that produces it. tools/results_macros.py turns this into generated/numbers.tex at every compile; a missing file or pointer prints as 'XXX Result Pending-<job>'. Seeded 2026-09-24; the full conversion of NUMBERS.md rows into keys is the next manuscript pass. 2026-09-24 restructure: the LevelCheck comparison keys (power_n_min_h1_822, power_n_min_h2_976, power_n_min_g6_level_90, fig6_h1_coupled_accuracy_pct, figures.figure6) moved to paper2_levelcheck/numbers_manifest_moved.json. 2026-09-24 fill pass: agesex_* keys (results/age_sex_by_source.json) and the coverage_hstar_lat_surgio_real pointer corrected to corpora/carmlspine_registered. 2026-09-25 data-case pass: 36 film_*/cov_* keys into results/coverage/pooled_fit.json (+ the conf-0.74 sensitivity); naming_lateral_cv_v9_* re-pointed to pre:cv5_det; det_carm_body_recall_074_* re-pointed to the learning-curve N = 0 row; kinds k_of_n, ci_bare and p added to results_macros.py; the five figure keys wired through \RESULTFIG.
